outputs: Generated answers to complex multi-hop questions with reasoning paths

changes_made.explanation: Normalized dataset name format and simplified model names by removing 'Instruct' suffix. Added more specific description of outputs to include intermediate reasoning steps.
Normalized metric name to standard capitalization. Only one metric (Accuracy) is explicitly mentioned for evaluation.

REMOVED all metadata - the paper does NOT use LLMs as judges. The models listed are used for generation/reasoning, not for evaluating outputs. The self-evaluation is part of the generation process (MCTS value scoring), not post-hoc evaluation by an LLM judge.
No human evaluation is mentioned in the paper. Only automatic evaluation using accuracy is conducted.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on retrieval-augmented generation for multi-hop question answering using Monte Carlo Tree Search. Evaluation is done exclusively through automatic accuracy measurement. The main contribution is the GRAT framework that combines MCTS with process rewards for improved reasoning. No human evaluation or LLM-as-judge evaluation is performed.
